gold-question: Show the names of students who have at least 2 likes.
gold-sql: SELECT T2.name FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2

gold-question: Show the names of students who have a grade higher than 5 and have at least 2 friends.
